## Mobile Mechanic for Personal & Fleet Vehicles in DC, Maryland & Virginia
URL: https://myhaloauto.com/
Last updated: 2026-10-01

My Halo Auto is a mobile auto repair and maintenance service for personal and fleet vehicles in Washington DC, Maryland and Virginia. An ASE-certified technician comes to your home, office, fleet lot or job site and does the work on-site.

Full cooling system diagnosis and repair.

Oil leak diagnosis and repair. Timing cover, valve cover, intake manifold, and rear main seal replacement.

Manual and automatic transmission repair, rebuilds, and replacements.

Q: How does mobile auto repair work?
A: You call or text (571) 969-4256, or use the form, and share the vehicle's year, make and model and what's going on. You get a transparent quote with no hidden fees, and we explain every repair before we start so you can approve the work. The technician then comes to your home, office, lot or job site and does the work on-site, with every fastener torqued to manufacturer specification and every repair following OEM procedures.
Q: What areas do you serve in the DMV?
A: We serve Washington DC (all four quadrants, including Capitol Hill and Georgetown), Maryland (including Silver Spring, Bethesda, Rockville, College Park, Bowie and Laurel) and Northern Virginia (including Arlington, Alexandria, Fairfax, Reston, Tysons and Manassas). See the full town lists for Washington, DC, Maryland and Northern Virginia.
Q: Do I need to tow my car to a shop?
A: Usually not. The technician comes to the vehicle at your home, office, lot or job site, so there's no towing, no ride-sharing and no waiting room. Mobile service needs an adequate, safe workspace, such as a flat driveway, parking lot or garage. Engine swaps and other major jobs cannot be done as mobile service; contact us to discuss them.
Q: What do you need at my location?
A: A flat, level area around the vehicle and room to work safely around it, such as a flat driveway, parking lot or garage.
Q: What work can you do on-site?
A: We handle most maintenance and repair work on-site including engine diagnostics, brake service, suspension, steering, transmission and clutch work, fluid services, and general maintenance. Major jobs like engine swaps require adequate workspace and are performed at a suitable location — not mobile. Contact us for details.
Q: What services can't you do on-site?
A: Engine swaps and other major jobs require adequate workspace and cannot be done as mobile service. Exhaust and custom fabrication require a consultation first. We do not offer bodywork or performance upgrades. Mobile service also requires sufficient space and a suitable work area at your location.
Q: Do you do engine swaps?
A: Yes, we do engine swaps — but not as a mobile service. Engine swaps require adequate workspace, proper equipment, and a suitable location. Contact us to discuss your project and we'll work out the best arrangement.
Q: What types of vehicles do you work on?
A: We work on all makes and models — domestic, import, and European. From daily drivers like Honda Accords and Toyota Camrys to trucks like Chevy Tahoes and Ford F-150s, to European vehicles like Mercedes-Benz and BMW, for personal and fleet vehicles alike. Jobs that need a full workspace are handled by consultation.
Q: Do you work on fleet or company vehicles?
A: Yes. My Halo Auto services company and fleet vehicles, including work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs, as well as personal vehicles. Service is performed on-site at your lot, yard or job site where there's adequate, safe workspace, and scheduling is arranged with your fleet manager. See our fleet services page.
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. Emergency mobile service is available. If you're stranded or need an urgent repair, call (571) 969-4256 and we'll get to you as fast as possible.
Q: Are you ASE Certified?
A: Yes. Joseph, the owner of My Halo Auto, is ASE (Automotive Service Excellence) certified and has 5+ years of hands-on experience.
Q: Who owns My Halo Auto?
A: My Halo Auto is owned by Joseph, an ASE-certified technician with 5+ years of hands-on experience.
Q: Do you use manufacturer torque specifications?
A: Absolutely. Every single fastener is torqued to the exact manufacturer specification using calibrated torque wrenches. We follow OEM repair procedures on every job — no shortcuts, no guesswork. This is non-negotiable for us.
Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call or text us at (571) 969-4256 or fill out the contact form on our website. Tell us your vehicle's year, make, and model, along with a description of the issue. We'll provide a transparent quote — no hidden fees, no surprises.
Q: Are there hidden fees?
A: No. You get a transparent quote with no hidden fees and no surprises. We explain every repair before we start, and you approve the work.
Q: What are your hours and availability?
A: We're available Monday through Saturday, 7AM to 7PM. Sunday appointments are available by request. We typically respond to inquiries within 12 hours during business hours.

## Mobile Fleet Maintenance & Repair in DC, Maryland & Virginia
URL: https://myhaloauto.com/fleet-services/
Last updated: 2026-10-01

ASE-certified maintenance and repair for company work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs, performed on-site at your lot, yard or job site.
### Does My Halo Auto work on fleet vehicles?
Yes. My Halo Auto provides mobile maintenance and repair for company and fleet vehicles, including work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs, throughout DC, Maryland and Virginia. An ASE-certified technician performs the work at your location, scheduled with your fleet manager, with an itemized invoice for each vehicle.
Built for businesses and the fleet managers who keep their company vehicles on the road. You get the same service catalog, the same standards and the same technician we provide for personal vehicles, brought to where your vehicles are parked, so they spend less time off the road.
#### Fleet service at a glance
Vehicles: Work vans, pickups, sedans, SUVs (all makes: domestic, import, European)
Where: Your lot, yard or job site (adequate, safe workspace required)
Services: Same catalog as personal vehicles
Scheduling: Arranged with your fleet manager
Contact: One ASE-certified technician
Invoicing: Itemized, per vehicle
Hours: Mon–Sat 7AM–7PM; Sunday by request
Area: Washington DC, Maryland, Virginia
### Why On-Site Service Cuts Downtime
What fleet managers get when the mechanic comes to the vehicles instead of the vehicles going to a shop.
#### Less downtime
No driving vehicles to a shop, no waiting rooms, no shuttling drivers back and forth. We come to where your vehicles are parked.
#### Scheduled with your fleet manager
Service is coordinated directly with the person managing your vehicles, Monday–Saturday 7AM–7PM, with Sunday by request.
#### One ASE-certified point of contact
Your vehicles are handled by the same certified technician, who explains each repair before work begins.
#### Itemized invoice per vehicle
Each vehicle gets its own itemized invoice, so you have a clear record of the work performed and its cost.
### Fleet Vehicles We Service
For businesses with company vehicles and the fleet managers responsible for keeping them maintained and working.

## Mobile Oil Leak, Gasket & Seal Repair in DC, Maryland & Virginia
URL: https://myhaloauto.com/services/gaskets-seals/
Last updated: 2026-10-01

My Halo Auto provides mobile oil leak, gasket and seal repair across DC, Maryland and Virginia. An ASE-certified technician diagnoses oil leaks and replaces timing cover, valve cover and intake manifold gaskets and rear main seals, done right the first time.
### What Does Mobile Gasket & Seal Repair Include?
Oil leak diagnosis and repair. Timing cover, valve cover, intake manifold, and rear main seal replacement.
#### Timing cover gasket
Seals the timing cover to the front of the engine. The old gasket is removed and the cover is refitted with a new gasket, torqued to manufacturer specification.
#### Valve cover gasket
Seals the valve cover to the top of the cylinder head. Replaced and torqued to manufacturer specification.
#### Intake manifold gasket
Seals the intake manifold to the cylinder head. Replaced and torqued to manufacturer specification.
#### Rear main seal replacement
Seals the rear of the crankshaft where it leaves the engine. The worn seal is replaced and surrounding fasteners are torqued to spec.
### Can Gasket & Seal Repair Be Done at My Location?
Most gasket and seal work is done on-site when there's adequate, safe workspace. Whether a specific job, such as a rear main seal, can be done at your location depends on the job and the workspace. Describe it when you request a quote and we'll work out the best arrangement.

### When to Schedule Maintenance
These are common reasons to book routine maintenance. If something points to a repair, the cause is confirmed with a hands-on diagnosis before any work is recommended.
- Oil change reminder or mileage due
- Rough idle or reduced fuel economy
- Squealing belts
- Cracked or soft hoses
- Fluids that look dark or low
Not sure? Describe what you're noticing when you request a quote.
### Photos from Our Work
Routine maintenance is available for personal vehicles and for company fleets: work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs, serviced at your lot, yard or job site.
### General Maintenance FAQ
Still have a question? Call or text (571) 969-4256.
Last updated: October 2026
Q: Do you do mobile oil changes?
A: Yes. Oil and filter changes are part of our general maintenance, done at your home, office or lot anywhere in our DC, Maryland and Virginia service area.
Q: What does general maintenance include?
A: Oil and filter changes, spark plug replacement, coolant and fluid flushes, and belt and hose replacement.
Q: Can you maintain our company vehicles?
A: Yes. Routine maintenance is available for company and fleet vehicles, including work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs, at your lot, yard or job site, scheduled with your fleet manager and invoiced per vehicle.
Q: How do I schedule maintenance?
A: Call or text (571) 969-4256 or use the contact form. We're available Monday through Saturday, 7AM to 7PM, with Sunday appointments by request, and we typically respond within 12 hours during business hours.

## Mobile service disclaimer

Mobile Service Disclaimer: Mobile service requires adequate workspace and a suitable area for the technician to safely perform repairs (e.g., a flat driveway, parking lot, or garage). Engine swaps, exhaust work, and other major services cannot be performed as mobile service and require a consultation. We do not offer bodywork, performance upgrades, or coilover installation. Exhaust and custom fabrication services require a prior consultation. My Halo Auto specializes in automotive maintenance and repair, not performance enhancement.
